description: Codified scoped-auto-improvement standing duty + drift-found role split (engineer surfaces; tech-lead resolves). Two-leg return shape (drift-found / scoped-improvement) is mandatory on every dispatch — absence is a positive claim, not a skip.

Doc claimed `noctus.dev.keeper_pattern_*` MCP tools exist but only CLI flags shipped. Doc-tool-coherence drift. Fixed on-contact in this commit by authoring `mcp/noctusai/tools/noctus/dev/keeper_pattern.py` MCP wrapper.

Third member of the keeper-mirror family (after keeper-pattern + agent-context). ndjson source + sqlite cache + 3 MCP tools + freshness keeper + pre-commit refresh + consult-before-editing discipline. Mirrors the sibling architecture per user mandate.

Cross-tree hazard recurrence (N=2 phases A+B): task_branch cleanup writes the salvage-ledger entry to the PRIMARY working tree, not the worktree's. Forces a follow-up self-branch+commit dance for the recovery pointer. The hazard is documented in noc-self-branch SKILL.md but not yet codified into a keeper or a tool-level fix. Candidate s3-kb→s4-keeper promotion: either change task_branch to write to the WORKTREE's ledger before remove OR add a check_post_cleanup_ledger_drift keeper.

First-cut refactor was too lean (54 → 42 lines, missing wide reach). User feedback: 'make sure the contextualize file has a wide reach of the platform'. Widened to 64 lines with domain map (backend/frontend/devops/security/compliance/integrations) + specialist agents + skills index + universal patterns. Keeper line cap raised 60 → 75 with codified rationale. Lesson: pointer-only ≠ minimal; pointer-only = no inline bodies (drift) but wide pointer coverage is good.

Codified pointer-only fresh-agent read map + new keeper check_contextualize_alignment (sibling of check_claude_md_router): canonical-cores allowlist + line cap + pre-commit gate. CLI flag --check-contextualize-alignment. KB pointer in CLAUDE.md §1 not added (CONTEXTUALIZE is root-level, not KB; keeper at compliance.py is enough).

N=3 codification of the REPO_ROOT cross-tree drift. Added (a) NOCTUSAI_HOME env override (explicit lever, highest priority), (b) worktree-boundary auto-detect in get_workspace_context (cwd inside `.claude/worktrees/<slug>/` resolves to the worktree, not the committed marker's PRIMARY-pointing noctusai_home), (c) safety-net boundary check in find_workspace_marker (handles marker-absent case). 7 regression tests including direct reproductions of Phase A + Phase B drifts. Skill noc-self-branch §Guardrails updated. Sibling cross-tree hazard (task_branch cleanup writes salvage to PRIMARY) is a separate issue tracked in s2-memory.

PATTERNS reorg by ownership (Phase B follow-up — task #14). Subfolders common/ + architect/ + backend/ + frontend/ + devops/ + security/ + compliance/. 77 file moves + 949 pointer updates (725 first-pass + 224 second-pass after regex-bug fix) across 154 files. Followed lossless-doc-refactor procedure: pointer-set + rule/section + line-structure + hook-grade-diff gates all passed. kb_sync green. Drift surfaced + closed in-flight: (a) regex negative-lookbehind blocked /PATTERNS/ form (CONTEXT/PATTERNS/* in compliance.py allowlist) — fixed via second pass; (b) scoped-auto-improvement.md missing from _AGENT_KB_UNOWNED_ALLOWLIST (Phase B gap) — added; (c) Layout-tree-in-INDEX needed regeneration with subfolder hierarchy.

Fourth keeper-mirror cache shipped: kb-vector-search. Storage = sqlite-vec (with pure-Python fallback). Embedding = OpenAI text-embedding-3-small via noctusai_lib.integrations.llm (no new external dep, same provider as ERP). 8 MCP tools: kb_search/kb_neighbors/kb_similar/kb_validate_owns_kb/kb_embeddings_refresh/kb_embeddings_list (high-level KB) + vector_embed/vector_status (low-level platform). Keeper check_kb_vector_canonical (severity WARNING — advisory layer, never blocks correctness). Codified principle: markdown canonical, vector DB is enrichment-only — NEVER moves content into the vector DB. 6 colocated tests passing. Deferred next-slices named in KB doc: kb_cluster (k-means topic clusters), kb_recurrence_radar (semantic auto-improvement consult), cross-product code-similarity.

Wave-1 N=4 surface: Agent tool's `isolation: "worktree"` parameter forked 4 of 5 engineers from a STALE base (7c2a778e — pre-Phase-B, weeks old) instead of current `origin/dev`. Engineers wrote code referencing modules that didn't exist in their worktree base; one engineer (E4) re-created `auto_improvement.py` + `vectorize.py` from scratch with incompatible APIs. The harness's built-in worktree isolation does NOT honor noc-self-branch's fork-from-origin/dev rule. CODIFIED in CLAUDE.md §1 (new dispatch-via-task_branch bullet) + KB § PATTERNS/architect/parallelization-first-orchestration.md (two-level branching section + new anti-pattern).

Two-level branching codified (user mandate): architect self-branches off origin/dev FIRST, then each engineer's worktree forks off architect's branch (NOT off dev). Architect collects + reconciles commits at architect-branch level BEFORE pushing to dev. Extra-insurance layer against engineer collisions + a deliberate reconciliation buffer. CLAUDE.md §1 + KB pattern updated.

Inline-specialist-empersonation rule codified (user mandate): when inline-deving (no dispatch), the architect still ROUTES BY DOMAIN — empersonate backend-engineer / frontend-engineer / devops-engineer / compliance-reviewer / security per task domain. Apply each specialist's discipline + owns_kb until the task's commit, then switch lens. Same rationale as dispatch decisions; only difference is empersonation vs. delegation. Empersonation matrix added to KB pattern doc.

The two-leg footer discipline (drift-found + scoped-improvement) PROVED its value in Wave-1: every stale-base engineer surfaced the issue in its own return footer (E5 explicit: 'the worktree's __init__.py was 15+ modules behind origin/dev'; E4 surfaced the API mismatch). The methodology's auto-immune response WORKED. Codification status confirmed s4-keeper — not changing anything, just recording the validation.

W2-E4' shipped: ported codification_radar to real auto_improvement.query() + vectorize.embed_text() dict-return APIs (E4's stale-base version used incompatible load_open_entries / EmbeddingUnavailableError / raw-list embed). 20 tests passing — cosine helpers + suggested_next progression + cluster happy paths + promote idempotent + malformed-line preservation + missing-ledger error path. Inline-empersonation of backend-engineer applied (graceful-degrade + no monkey-patch our own + clear API contract).

W2-E7 shipped (user mandate — REASON about signals, not blindly accept numbers). Observatory (vector_signal_log → vector-signals.ndjson) + Reasoner (vector_calibration_analyze produces structured reasoning lines with WHY clauses, never auto-applies) + Decision ledger (vector_calibration_decide REQUIRES reasoning argument) + History (vector_calibration_history reads past calls with rationale). 16 tests passing covering: ledger primitives, validation gates (signal_type/parameter/reasoning required), analyze too-few-warning + Q25-Q75-discriminating-range reasoning + histogram-shape reasoning + since-filter. KB § PATTERNS/common/vector-calibration.md. Inline-empersonation of backend-engineer applied. Future per-signal-type analyzers framework in place; canonical-truth cross-reference logic land as follow-up.

W2-E3' shipped: fifth keeper-mirror cache mirroring kb_embeddings.py. Source-tree walker (mcp/, noctusai_lib/, products/seed/), stdlib-ast chunking for Python (top-level FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef/ClassDef + whole-file fallback for unparseable / no-top-level-defs), whole-file chunking for TS/TSX. sqlite-vec fast path + JSON+pure-Python fallback. 5 MCP tools (code_search + code_neighbors + code_similar_to_text + code_embeddings_refresh + code_embeddings_list), check_code_embeddings_cache_freshness keeper (warning), CLI flags, pre-commit auto-refresh leg 9c, vector_costs instrumentation, vectorize.register_cache integration. 30 tests passing. Fixed-in-flight: CLI --check-kb-embeddings-cache-freshness was pointing at non-existent function name (actual: check_kb_vector_canonical) — bug surfaced by sibling code-embeddings keeper arrival. KB § CONTEXT/PATTERNS/common/code-embeddings.md. Inline-empersonation of backend-engineer applied.

W2-E6 shipped: ratified-canonical layer over kb_validate_owns_kb. Durable JSON snapshots in project-history/kb-baselines/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<short-corpus-sha>.json (append-only ledger of decisions; same-corpus second-ratification gets -<N> suffix). kb_ratify(reason, findings?) requires non-empty reason; kb_baseline_diff(against?) returns new/resolved findings + kb_corpus_drifted flag; kb_baseline_list chronological summary; latest() helper. check_kb_semantic_drift keeper (warning) fires (a) baseline-missing + current_count>0, (b) new_findings > _DRIFT_THRESHOLD (5), (c) kb_corpus_drifted. 25 tests passing covering finding-key stability, corpus_sha determinism + change detection, empty-reason rejection, file write + non-overwrite, live findings auto-pull, latest/list chronology, diff (no-baseline + unknown-id + new + resolved + corpus-drift flagged + unchanged-not-flagged), keeper integration (silent without KB + suggests-ratify + drift-above-threshold + silent-below-threshold), current_findings defensive path. KB § CONTEXT/PATTERNS/common/vector-baseline.md. Inline-empersonation of backend-engineer applied. Composes with vector_calibration (sister reasoning-driven tool: thresholds vs findings).

Roadmap FILED at user request. E1 + E2 ticked verified (exercised in-session during builds — verification implicit). E3 / E4 / E5 / W2-E3' / W2-E4' / W2-E6 / W2-E7 shipped tests-green but NOT exercised against live caches / live MCP tool calls beyond unit-test surface. Closure note + per-slice verify recipes appended for the next agent picking up the verification pass. Lesson: tests-green ≠ verified-in-production; the unit-test surface stops at module boundaries — runtime verification against live state (OpenAI provider, ndjson ledgers, MCP server registration round-trip) is a SEPARATE phase that should be explicit in every roadmap from the start. Codify candidate: every roadmap slice carries a verify-recipe in addition to a test-recipe.

Post-close W3-E1 shipped: closes the cross-product recurrence loop. scan(threshold, top_k_per_file, limit) walks every anchor in code-embeddings cache → dedupes pairs (canonical-ordered by sorted path+symbol) → groups by score-band (strong ≥0.9 / medium ≥0.8 / weak ≥0.7) → returns ordered clusters. promote(matches) writes each as s1-emergent `improvement` entry to auto-improvement.ndjson with target='code-recurrence:<p1>::<s1> ≈ <p2>::<s2>' (canonical order is the idempotency key — skip_existing default True). 22 tests passing covering: band classifier, pair canonicalization (symmetric + path/symbol lex), scan (empty/threshold/dedupe/band-count/band-sort/limit), promote (writes/canonical-target/idempotent/skip-existing-toggle/invalid-status/malformed/score/source_ref), pipeline round-trip (scan→promote→re-scan-skips-all). Discovered+fixed-in-flight: auto_improvement.STATUSES validates kind enum to {drift, improvement} — used kind=improvement (recurrence is a class of improvement) with target prefix 'code-recurrence:' as the slice-specific tag. The DRY recurrence-discovery → codification loop is now AUTOMATIC end-to-end. Inline-empersonation of backend-engineer applied. KB § CONTEXT/PATTERNS/common/code-embeddings.md § Deferred (now ✅ shipped).

Post-close W3-E2 shipped: sister of kb_baseline applied to code recurrence findings. ratify(reason, matches?, threshold?) → snapshot to project-history/code-baselines/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<corpus-sha>.json (append-only); diff(against?, threshold?) → new_matches + resolved_matches + code_corpus_drifted flag; latest()/list_baselines(). _code_corpus_sha hashes code-embeddings cache rows (path+symbol+source_sha tuples sorted) — identifies which code state was ratified. check_code_recurrence_drift keeper (warning) fires on baseline-missing+pairs, drift>3 NEW (smaller threshold than kb_baseline's 5 since code signal sparser), or corpus-drifted. 24 tests covering pair_key canonicality, corpus_sha determinism, empty-reason rejection, append-only behavior, live-scan-when-omitted, chronological list, no-baseline-all-new, surfaces-only-new, surfaces-resolved, corpus-drift-flagged, keeper integration paths. KB § CONTEXT/PATTERNS/common/code-recurrence-baseline.md. Inline-empersonation of backend-engineer applied.

Post-close W3-E3 shipped: semantic consult-before-editing over auto-improvement.ndjson. consult(text?, path?, top_k, min_score, open_only, limit_entries) → embeds query → cosine vs every open entry's description → top-K ranked hits with key_overlap transparency flag. Complements keyword-based auto_improvement.query by surfacing entries that DESCRIBE a surface without naming it. In-session embedding cache keyed by sha256(description) → descriptions embedded ONCE per process (one OpenAI batch for typical N≤100 open entries). When path is a .md file, prepends H1 title to query for stronger signal. Graceful-degrades to empty hits on provider unreachable. 17 tests covering: entry_sha cache stability, cosine, validation (requires text-or-path), empty-entries/provider-failure paths, ranking (identical scores top, top_k limit, min_score filter), key_overlap transparency, embedding cache (embed-once + invalidate-on-mutation), markdown H1 query construction, full pipeline. KB § CONTEXT/PATTERNS/common/kb-recurrence-radar.md. Inline-empersonation of backend-engineer applied.

Scoped-improvement promoted: the 'code-recurrence:' target prefix was load-bearing in 3 places (target_string + scan dedupe references + promote idempotency) flagged in W3-E1 commit footer. Promoted to module-level CODE_RECURRENCE_TARGET_PREFIX constant; exported in __all__. Any future refactor renaming the prefix now moves all referents together (also referenced now by code_baseline + kb_recurrence_radar siblings — total 5 places). Standard string-as-load-bearing → constant promotion when N≥3.
